title: Armor Lock
description: This plug in makes it so player(s) are not able to take off their armor with a command.
body: This mod was made for the [Aspirant SMP](https://discord.com/invite/VHEGaCr5VC), the main function of the mod is to make it so if your hosting an event or a large player gathering and you do not want players removing armor, you can use this mod to easily prevent them from doing so with /armorlock. You can also use it to lock individual players. This mod is also compatible with the vanilla teams feature (/armorlock team (team name)).
